name: Ichinose Konoha
source:
A girl who is honest with her own feelings - during fun times she will laugh with all her might, and during sorrowful times she will cry in a loud voice. She is mischievous and often gets caught by the nurses.

[Based on the [url=http://www.oaks-soft.co.jp/princess-soft/21twoone/21chara.html]official site[/url]]
